scripts.author: jesus2099
touches: Global CSS (ROW_HIGHLIGHTER, default ON): pink row-hover background via 'div#content table.tbl > tbody > tr:hover > td' — matches ANY table.tbl on the page, including ShowAllEntityData's own rendered tables, regardless of load order.
Global CSS (SPOT_CAA, default ON): box-shadow on CAA/EAA thumbnails.
Global CSS (HIDE_RATINGS, default OFF/opt-in): hides 'td.rating'/'th.rating' cells entirely if the user enabled it.

Work/artist-relationships/place-performances pages (RECORDING_LENGTH_COLUMN, default ON): adds its own extra column to the NATIVE MusicBrainz relationships table by reusing the 'treleases' class (never native on these page types) plus a title tooltip and yellow header text-shadow — this is exactly what _isJesus2099Treleases()/purgeJesus2099Artifacts() in ShowAllEntityData.user.js detect and strip.
Label/artist-relationships pages (RELEASE_EVENT_COLUMN, default ON): same treleases-reuse mechanism, for release dates instead of recording lengths.

SPOT_AC (default ON): dashed maroon underline on '.name-variation'/'.artist-credit-variation' spots — a second, CSS-only mechanism for the same 'name differs' signal INLINE-STUFF marks via the title attribute.

TAG_TOOLS/MARK_PENDING_EDIT_MEDIUMS/USER_STATS/RELEASE_CLONER/TRACKLIST_TOOLS/etc. touch pages or areas ShowAllEntityData doesn't render (release editor, tag pages, user stats) — not expected to interact visibly.

scripts.author: Lotheric
touches:
Replaces MusicBrainz's native CSS-sprite country flags with Wikimedia SVG elements placed on the RIGHT of the text. processFlags() selects '.flag:not([data-hq-processed]):not([data-hq-skip])' — ANY tag, so it matches ShowAllEntityData's own '
  • ' (Release events) and '' (Release country) cells, not just native markup.

Two DIFFERENT shapes, and which one you get depends on whether the .flag element contains an 'a[href*="/area/"]'. WITH a link (native Country/Date, and any area chain): the flag is only neutralized and the img goes into a new 'span.mfe-flag-wrapper' around the anchor. WITHOUT a link (ShowAllEntityData's injected Release events/Release country cells): 'el.appendChild(img)' puts 'img.mb-hq-flag-img' INSIDE the .flag element itself, after its text. Only the first shape is excluded by openUniqDrop()'s iconSel ':not(:has(span.mfe-flag-wrapper))' guard.

Neutralizes the element it processes with inline '!important' styles (background-image:none, padding-left:0, background-position/size/repeat) and stamps 'data-hq-processed="true"' + 'data-hq-code="XX"'. The injected img carries class 'mb-hq-flag-img', 'data-hq-flag="XX"', alt="" and aria-hidden — so it contributes NO text and cannot affect filter/sort text.

Injects a '<style id="mfe-loading-style">' whose first rule is '.flag:not([data-hq-processed]):not([data-hq-skip]) { background-image: none !important; }'. An author '!important' rule beats a normal inline declaration, so it blanks ANY .flag-classed node that lacks those two attributes — including a clone ShowAllEntityData bakes into its 📊 dropdown, which the observer below then decorates with a second flag.

insertFlags() separately scans 'a[href*="/area/"]' and '<h1>' headings, wrapping the anchor in 'span.mfe-flag-wrapper' and adding 'class="arealink"' plus 'data-mb-flag' — the shape _findAreaLinkIcon()/AREA_ICON_WRAPPER_SEL already recognize.

Installs a MutationObserver on document.documentElement ({childList:true, subtree:true}, 100 ms debounce) running processFlags + insertFlags + cleanupOrphanedFlags — so it re-decorates after EVERY ShowAllEntityData re-render (each filter keystroke, each sort, each cloneNode(true) rebuild), and also decorates DOM ShowAllEntityData appends to document.body such as the unique-values dropdown panel.
Non-visual: fetches flag SVGs from commons.wikimedia.org / upload.wikimedia.org via GM_xmlhttpRequest.
Non-visual: caches flag data in an IndexedDB database 'MusicBrainzRightSideFlags', and clears any legacy 'mb_hq_flag_cache_*' localStorage keys at startup.
Non-visual: exposes window.MBHQ_processFlags. Harness-compatible — classic GM_* only (no GM.* dot syntax) and no top-level await.

scripts.author: sanojjonas
touches: Builds and appends its OWN new colored schedule/timetable <table> into div#content on artist/event/place/instrument/series pages (its doStuff() has its own `case "series":` branch) — festival lineup visualizations for a fixed set of known festivals (aff/clubAff/floatline/pukkelpop/graspop), fetched as JSON from a gitlab.io-hosted userscript asset host.
Adds a manual 'Visualise' toggle button rather than always auto-running (unless config.autoVisualise is enabled).

Does NOT modify ShowAllEntityData's own rendered table.tbl rows directly — lower expected DOM-collision risk than the jesus2099/More-Flags scripts — but it does append into the same div#content container ShowAllEntityData targets, so a render-order/placement conflict is still possible.

CAVEAT: its body opens with top-level 'await' (const aff = await getJsonFile(...)), which only runs inside an ES module or an async function — tests/support/liveUserscripts.js wraps every injected body in an async IIFE specifically so this script doesn't throw a SyntaxError on injection.
Non-visual: reads/writes localStorage (nextMap-<mbid> cache).
Non-visual: loads an external add-to-calendar-button@2 script from a CDN (cdn.jsdelivr.net).
Non-visual: @grant none — its fetch() calls go straight to the network, not through GM_xmlhttpRequest/gmStubs.js.

scripts.author: ChatGPT
touches: Header @author is literally 'ChatGPT'; the script is aerozol's (namespace github.com/Aerozol/metabrainz-userscripts). No @run-at, so Tampermonkey's default document-idle — hence 'now'.

Everything below hangs off addTaggingUI(), which returns at once unless the sidebar '#tag-form' (with 'input.tag-input' + 'button.styled-button') exists — i.e. on an entity page while logged in. Logged out, the script does nothing visible.

Sidebar tag form: appends a 'div.elephant-tags-wrapper' holding 'div.tag-shortcuts' (🧠 brain button, repeat-last-tag button, one 'button.tag-shortcut-btn' per remembered tag) and, when a bulk context is detected, a collapsible 'div.nuclear-bulk-wrapper' ('Nuclear Options (Bulk Actions) ▼/▲') with cascade toggles and a progress line.

Release page (pageContext 'release', needs 'table.tbl.medium'): addRecordingCheckboxes() PREPENDS a '<th class="elephant-tag-col">' (master checkbox, name 'elephant-tag-master') to each medium's 'tr.subh' and a '<td class="elephant-tag-col">' (checkbox, name 'elephant-tag-checkbox') to every 'tbody > tr' that has a 'td.pos' — so the native tracklist gains a NEW FIRST COLUMN and every cell index shifts by one.

Consequence of the leading cell: any other script that locates the title cell by position or by exclusion now hits the checkbox cell instead. Confirmed with jesus2099-inline-stuff: its 'td:not(.pos):not(.video)' title-cell lookup lands its AcoustID/ISRC blocks in 'td.elephant-tag-col' (debug/ISRC-OK.html vs debug/ISRC-bug.html; fix in debug/mb_INLINE-STUFF.user.js + debug/mb_INLINE-STUFF-title-cell.patch).

Series page (pageContext 'series_<type>', type sniffed from the first row's links): addSeriesCheckboxes() prepends the same 'th/td.elephant-tag-col' column to the FIRST 'table.tbl' on the page (header 'thead tr', every row with a 'td' and no 'th').

Artist / label / release-group pages: adds NO column — it reuses MusicBrainz's own 'input[name="add-to-merge"]' checkboxes (artist page: 'table.release-group-list'; release-group: 'table.tbl:not(.medium)').

One-shot per tag form, not per render: a WeakSet plus a '.elephant-tags-wrapper' presence check stop re-injection, and each table is skipped once its head row has 'th.elephant-tag-col'. ShowAllEntityData's re-rendered tables therefore do NOT get checkbox cells — only the native table present when the form was first processed.

Hydration race (intermittent): if addRecordingCheckboxes() runs BEFORE MusicBrainz's React hydrates the tracklist (a DOMContentLoaded handler calling flushSync), the extra cells cause React error #418; React empties 'div.tracklist-and-credits' and renders it again, and the one-shot guard never re-adds the column. Whether it hits depends on load timing (other installed scripts, ShowAllEntityData included, shift it). ShowAllEntityData and INLINE STUFF are NOT the remover — scripts/probe-nuclear-tags-column-loss.js logs React's stack. Under the harness ('init' = DOMContentLoaded) it hits on every run. Fix: debug/MusicBrainz Nuclear Tags.user.js + debug/MusicBrainz-Nuclear-Tags-restore-checkbox-column.patch (run the probe with --fixed-nuclear).

Global CSS via GM_addStyle: '.elephant-tags-wrapper', '.tag-shortcuts', '.nuclear-*' button/toggle/progress/status rules and '.elephant-tag-col { width: 20px; }'. None of it targets 'table.tbl' itself.

Re-runs continuously: a MutationObserver on document.body ({childList, subtree}) calls addTaggingUI() on EVERY body mutation — including every ShowAllEntityData re-render — but the guards above make that a cheap early return; a second observer on '#tag-form' re-renders the shortcut buttons if MusicBrainz's React re-renders the form.
Non-visual: GM_getValue/GM_setValue keys 'mbz_tag_shortcuts', 'mbz_last_submitted_tag', 'mbz_elephant_tags_bulk_expanded'; localStorage 'nuclear_tags_chunk_size' / 'nuclear_tags_benchmark'.

Non-visual: only on a user's bulk-tag click — fetch() to /ws/2/release-group|release?inc=…&fmt=json (fetchWithRetry, 1 s spacing) and POST /ws/2/tag?client=MusicBrainzNuclearTags-1.6 in chunks (1.1 s spacing, backoff on failure). Plain fetch(), not GM_xmlhttpRequest, so gmStubs.js does not intercept it.
Harness-compatible: classic GM_* only (GM_addStyle/GM_getValue/GM_setValue, all stubbed by gmStubs.js), no top-level await.

scripts.author: Michael Wiencek
touches: No @run-at (Tampermonkey default document-idle, which would map to 'now'), registered as 'init' on purpose: it decorates the NATIVE artist-recordings table long before the user clicks a ShowAllEntityData button — debug/A-R-3rd-works.html is an IP snapshot with its markup already on the native rows. 'now' would instead run it over ShowAllEntityData's own rendered table, which never happens in a real browser.
@match *://*.musicbrainz.org/artist/*/recordings* only (pageType artist-recordings). It returns at once when no 'tr:has(a[href*="/recording/"])' exists.

Page-context injection: the whole body is stringified into a <script> appended to document.body, with GM_info JSON-serialised into the source. It then uses the page's own jQuery ($, from MusicBrainz's synchronous jquery-global bundle) and MB.constants (LANGUAGE_MUL_ID/LANGUAGE_ZXX_ID). In the harness GM_info is gmStubs.js's, so its edit-note signature would read 'ShowAllEntityData (test)'.

Name cell: appends '<div class="work">' ('<attrs> recording of <a href=/work/…>') for each performance relationship, and '<div class="suggested-work">' (orange 'Looking for matching work… N/M' while matching, then green bold 'Suggested work:' + work link). Both are removed from ShowAllEntityData's Name column by the 'wiencek' columnEraser on artist-recordings (buildActiveColumnErasers, Strategy 4).

Header + every recording row: appends a '<th>Performance Attributes</th>' and a 'td.bpr_attrs' cell (clickable part./live/inst./cover spans, blue when 'checked', plus a yyyy-mm-dd input.bpr-date-input). Always stripped by cleanupHeaders()'s removalMapAlways (and its index-tracking copy) and, if it arrives late, by _stripForeignHeaderTh in _watchForLateJesus2099Injections().

Inserts its own control table (grey #F2F2F2 box: 'Relate checked recordings to…', 'Cached works' with 'N works loaded for <artist> (cached <date>)' + Reload, Edit Note textarea, filter input, 'Hide recordings with performance ARs' / '…pending edits' checkboxes) directly after the first 'div#content h2'.
Hides native rows with jQuery .hide() (filter input, the two hide checkboxes, which persist in localStorage) and re-stripes odd/even classes — on the native table only.

Non-visual: WS/2 through jQuery $.get with its own ~1 req/s RequestManager — /ws/2/recording?artist=<mbid>&inc=work-rels&limit=100&offset=…, /ws/2/recording/<mbid>?inc=work-rels (filtered pages), /ws/2/recording/<mbid>?inc=releases+release-groups (to guess 'live' from a Live release group), /ws/2/work?artist=<mbid>&inc=aliases&limit=100 (the cached work list), plus /dialog?path=/work/create and /release/add HTML scraped for the work-type and language selects.
Non-visual, outward-facing: only on a user's 'Go' click — POST /relationship-editor (link_type 278, performance) and POST /work/create, ~1 per 1.5 s. Never triggered by loading the page.

Non-visual: localStorage keys 'bpr_works <artistMbid>' (newline-separated '<mbid><title>' + optional '\u00a0<comment>'), 'bpr_works_date <artistMbid>' (a Date().toString()), 'bpr_artists <artistMbid>' (extra artists whose works are loaded), and settings 'bpr_make_votable', 'bpr_hide_performed_recs', 'bpr_hide_pending_edits', 'bpr_work_type', 'bpr_work_language'.

Harness: no GM_* call besides reading GM_info (stubbed); no top-level await. Not runnable on a local fixture (needs the page's $ and MB). tests/pagetypes.json has no artist-recordings entry, so a smoke run needs --url plus --show-all-button.
